status_note: Model v0.4: as v0.3 (stacking weights frozen on 2022-2023 validation) with the official-report participation adjustment estimated on 2016-2021 instead of guessed. Every model is recorded so each has a genuine pre-match record. Probabilities are conditional on the player taking part (most bookmakers void a player prop if he does not play). No bookmaker prices were available to this edition, so no value claims are made.
